## Data Sources

- **Louisiana Department of Education:** LEAP 2025 Assessment Master Results (2018–2025). Data was retrieved directly from official state testing reports published on the Louisiana Department of Education portal.
- **South Carolina Department of Education:** SC READY Assessment Results (2021–2025). Data was retrieved from public district-level and statewide assessment files made available by the South Carolina Department of Education.

## Software & Package Citations

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
pkgs <- c("base", "tidyverse", "dplyr", "readr", "parsnip", "broom", "gt", "marginaleffects", "ggplot2")

for (p in pkgs) {
  pkg_name <- if (p == "base") "R (Base System)" else paste("Package:", p)
  cat("### ", pkg_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cit <- format(citation(p), style = "text")
  cat(paste(cit, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n")
}
```
